# Honora Hollis

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is fair, light-haired, and ethereal in appearance, with radiant golden beauty. She is taller than average, standing two inches higher than her peers at Wexcombe.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Despite her dreamlike and delicate exterior, Honora is packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She possesses a graver outlook on existence than some of her peers, yet remains lively, friendly, and prone to shared laughter. She is a driven and contemplative scholar who appreciates the beauty of the world, literature, and nature.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_

## History

Honora studied at Regent's Academy alongside Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. She later took up a teaching position at the Delford school and became an active member of the Brierley Village Improvement Society, giving essays and presentations to the group. During the summer, she arranged for Nell and Isolde to meet her aunt, author Charlotte E. Varley.

Honora enrolled at Wexcombe College for higher studies, where she roomed with Nell Harcourt. Together with Nell and Mabel Colby, she helped set up house at Tabby's Place, later agreeing to let Cressida Lindsay join their modest household. She successfully completed her examinations with Honors in Classics. Eventually, Honora married a foreign missionary and relocated to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c10 P60](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0060), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
